name: casegraph
description: Investigation-first case graph for personal federal case work.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/cases/import/courtlistener/docket && cp src/cases/import/courtlistener/docket/*.yaml dist/cases/import/courtlistener/docket/ && mkdir -p dist/cases/analysis && cp -R src/cases/analysis/workflows dist/cases/analysis/ && cp -R src/cases/analysis/tasks dist/cases/analysis/
scripts.validate: npm run format && npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run openspec:validate
